items.headline: DeepSeek releases experimental multimodal DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp is an experimental API model that adds image input to V4-Flash while, per DeepSeek, matching it on text tasks. DeepSeek claims multimodal agent performance close to Claude Opus 4.8; a free Files API launched alongside it.
